messages:
deploybot: Canary promotion aborted for image ghcr.redwood/inference/api:2026-03-20-rc1 — missing manifest for linux/arm64. /promote skipped.

buildkite: CI shows push succeeded but manifest list step failed on the mirror.

emma: I can repro locally — `docker manifest inspect ghcr.redwood/inference/api:2026-03-20-rc1` only returns linux/amd64.

carl: release job's `create-manifest` step timed out on one arch due to a transient layer upload error. snippet:
```
Error: failed to upload layer: timeout while uploading blob
```

maya_sre: Canary pods in eu-west-1 are failing pull for arm64: "manifest for ... not found". Canary was 10% traffic.

jordan_rl: Reminder — change window opens 18:00 UTC. Options: delay full rollout, pin canary to previous digest, or rollback. Thoughts?

emma: Fastest is to pin canary to previous digest `sha256:abcd1234` and republish manifest list afterwards. I'll prep a changelog/blurb.

carl: I can re-run the `release-manifest` job to regenerate the manifest list and repush. Cosign attestation will be reissued — fine as long as we note it.

maya_sre: For audit we should capture that attestation timestamp changed and call it out in release notes.

jordan_rl: OK. Emma/Carl do pin + PR with release-note. I'll update change window message and hold full rollout until verification.

emma: Doing pin now: `kustomize edit set image api=ghcr.redwood/inference/api@sha256:abcd1234` — opening PR and adding `release:hold` label.

deploybot: Update: canary image pinned to sha256:abcd1234, rollout set to 10% and paused for verification. Alerts routed to #incidents.

buildkite: Queued `release-manifest/2026-03-20` with republish flag. CI logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/5678

carl: After manifest push I'll run `cosign sign` + `cosign verify` and post outputs. ETA ~20m.

emma: Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/789 — short note: "Temporarily pinned canary due to manifest creation failure; republishing multi-arch manifest in progress."

jordan_rl: Plan: if manifests and canary healthy within 30m we'll resume rollout inside the change window; otherwise rollback to stable tag and schedule maintenance. I'll post final decision here.

maya_sre: Watching metrics now :eyes:

deploybot: Canary health check passed for amd64. Awaiting manifest job result for arm64. Will post status update when done.
